amd64.description: 64-bit x86 PCs: Intel and AMD processors. The 'amd64' in the file name is the standard linux name for 64-bit x86 and runs on Intel CPUs. Do NOT use a -rocm file unless you have an AMD graphics card.

arm64.description: 64-bit ARM PCs such as Raspberry Pi 5 and ARM laptops.

unsupported.reason: Ollama only publishes 64-bit builds. 32-bit x86 (i386/i686) and 32-bit ARM cannot run Ollama; use a 64-bit OS install instead.

notes: The 1.4 GB runtime archive is NOT stored in Git; this manifest pins the version and file names so every Milelik install downloads the exact same tested release.
The plain 'amd64' archive already includes NVIDIA GPU support and CPU fallback. The separate '-rocm' archive is only for AMD graphics cards.
Milelik verifies the downloaded archive against the release's sha256sum.txt before extracting it.
